# STRATUM

> STRATUM is a free music production app (a digital audio workstation, or DAW) for Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad and Android, made by Matova LC. It is free during the alpha.

- Current version: Alpha v10.9 (0.1.0-alpha.10.9)
- Mac: macOS 12 or later, Apple silicon and Intel
- Windows: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- Phones and tablets: runs as a web app you add to your home screen
- Opens: FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro and Reason projects, MIDI, DAWproject
- Plugins: VST3 and VST2 on Mac and Windows, Audio Units on Mac
- Also: AI stem separation, audio-reactive visuals, 1080p share videos, live streaming to Twitch, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok
